name: Nginx Proxy Manager
author: Atrium
description: Your proxy hosts and SSL certificates, with expiry dates.

baseUrl.title: Admin URL
baseUrl.description: The admin address of Nginx Proxy Manager, usually port 81, for example http://10.0.0.6:81.

secrets.label: API token
secrets.hint: A token from POST /api/tokens with an admin or read-only user's email and password. Atrium sends it as a Bearer token and only reads.

endpoints.label: Proxy hosts
endpoints.description: Every proxy host with its forward target, whether it is enabled and its SSL state.

endpoints.label: Certificates
endpoints.description: Every SSL certificate with its domains and expiry time.
